# GENERATED by tools/gen_wif_sam.py - edit the generator, not this file.

# SAM Battery fire control. Runs weekly for every country (common/on_actions/wif_sam_on_actions.txt).
# Country variables: wif_sam_hs_hit / wif_sam_rd_hit (hit chance %, after every modifier),
# wif_sam_enemy_planes, wif_sam_enemy_cas, wif_sam_fired_total.
# State variables: wif_sam_hit (% this week), wif_sam_hit_factor (the modifier), wif_sam_used.

wif_sam_weekly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_tech = wif_sam_battery_tech
			any_owned_state = { wif_sam_battery > 0 }
		}
		wif_sam_estimate_threat = yes
		wif_sam_fire = yes
	}
}

# The script can't see which planes fly where, so it estimates the average enemy plane from
# every enemy at war, weighted by how many planes each has deployed.
wif_sam_estimate_threat = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_t_w = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_t_hs = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_t_rd = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_t_cas = 0 }
	every_enemy_country = {
		set_temp_variable = { wif_t_n = num_deployed_planes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_n > 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_cas = num_deployed_planes_with_type@cas }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_tech = jet_engines } }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 35 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 90 }
			}
			else = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_tech = modern_small_airframe_7 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 21 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 33 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_tech = modern_small_airframe_6 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 24 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 40 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_tech = modern_small_airframe_5 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 27 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 45 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_tech = modern_small_airframe_4 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 46 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 66 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_tech = modern_small_airframe_3 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 48 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 70 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_tech = modern_small_airframe_2 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 59 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 80 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_tech = modern_small_airframe_1 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 70 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 90 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_tech = modern_small_airframe }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 60 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 90 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 35 }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 90 }
			}
			}
			# Agility bonuses: +30 % takes about a fifth off.
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_div = modifier@air_agility_factor }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_div = 0.83 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_div = 1 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_t_div min = 0.5 max = 5 }
			divide_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = wif_t_div }
			divide_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = wif_t_div }
			if = {
				limit = { has_tech = dragchut }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = 15 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_tech = dragchut2 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = 15 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_ehs = wif_t_n }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_erd = wif_t_n }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_hs = wif_t_ehs }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_rd = wif_t_erd }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_w = wif_t_n }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_w > 0 } }
		divide_temp_variable = { wif_t_hs = wif_t_w }
		divide_temp_variable = { wif_t_rd = wif_t_w }
	}
	else = {
		# Nobody to shoot at: show the 1950-jet baseline.
		set_temp_variable = { wif_t_hs = 70 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_t_rd = 90 }
	}
	# Owner's missile techs (SAM missiles only).
	if = {
		limit = { has_tech = aam60 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_hs = 10 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_rd = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_tech = aam70 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_hs = 7 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_rd = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_tech = aam80 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_hs = 7 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_rd = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_tech = pesa }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_rd = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_tech = aesa }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_rd = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_tech = lpi_radar }
		add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_rd = 5 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_t_hs min = 5 max = 90 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_t_rd min = 5 max = 90 }
	set_variable = { wif_sam_hs_hit = wif_t_hs }
	set_variable = { wif_sam_rd_hit = wif_t_rd }
	set_variable = { wif_sam_enemy_planes = wif_t_w }
	set_variable = { wif_sam_enemy_cas = wif_t_cas }
}

wif_sam_fire = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_t_rds = num_equipment@wif_rd_sam_equipment_1 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_t_hss = num_equipment@wif_hs_sam_equipment_1 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_t_mult = 5 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_sam_enemy_planes > 499 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_t_mult = 10 }
	}
	# The country's own AA hit chance bonus (UTTNH radar techs) is subtracted so the
	# missile table holds; normal AA guns elsewhere keep it.
	set_temp_variable = { wif_t_cf = modifier@static_anti_air_hit_chance_factor }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_t_fired = 0 }
	every_owned_state = {
		if = {
			limit = { wif_sam_battery > 0 }
			set_variable = { wif_sam_used = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_lvl = building_level@wif_sam_battery }
			# 1. Pay for last week's engagements.
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_controlled_by = ROOT
					OR = {
						days_since_last_strategic_bombing < 8
						AND = {
							ROOT = { check_variable = { wif_sam_enemy_cas > 0 } }
							any_neighbor_state = { controller = { has_war_with = ROOT } }
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_need = wif_t_lvl }
				multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_need = wif_t_mult }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_used = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_take = wif_t_need }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_take > wif_t_rds } }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_take = wif_t_rds }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_take > 0 } }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_rds = wif_t_take }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_need = wif_t_take }
				add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_used = wif_t_take }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_neg = wif_t_take }
				multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_neg = -1 }
				ROOT = { add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = wif_rd_sam_equipment_1 amount = wif_t_neg } }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_take = wif_t_need }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_take > wif_t_hss } }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_take = wif_t_hss }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_take > 0 } }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_hss = wif_t_take }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_need = wif_t_take }
				add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_used = wif_t_take }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_neg = wif_t_take }
				multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_neg = -1 }
				ROOT = { add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = wif_hs_sam_equipment_1 amount = wif_t_neg } }
			}
				set_variable = { wif_sam_used = wif_t_used }
				add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_fired = wif_t_used }
			}
			# 2. Fire control for the coming week, from what is in stock for one week's need.
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_n5 = wif_t_lvl }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_n5 = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_r = wif_t_rds }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_r > wif_t_n5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_r = wif_t_n5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_h = wif_t_n5 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_h = wif_t_r }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_h > wif_t_hss } }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_h = wif_t_hss }
			}
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_t_h min = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_g = wif_t_n5 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_g = wif_t_r }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_g = wif_t_h }
			# Missile damage: DAMAGE_BONUS x the share of the week's need that is missiles.
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_d = wif_t_r }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_d = wif_t_h }
			divide_temp_variable = { wif_t_d = wif_t_n5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_d = 3.3 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_r = ROOT.wif_sam_rd_hit }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_h = ROOT.wif_sam_hs_hit }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_t_g = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_hit = wif_t_r }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_hit = wif_t_h }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_t_hit = wif_t_g }
			divide_temp_variable = { wif_t_hit = wif_t_n5 }
			set_variable = { wif_sam_hit = wif_t_hit }
			# chance = 10 % x (1 + factor)  ->  factor = hit / 10 - 1 - country bonus
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_f = wif_t_hit }
			divide_temp_variable = { wif_t_f = 10 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_f = 1 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_f = wif_t_cf }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_t_f min = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_f = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_t_d = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { wif_sam_hit_factor = wif_t_f }
			set_variable = { wif_sam_dmg_factor = wif_t_d }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						check_variable = { wif_sam_hit_factor > 0 }
						check_variable = { wif_sam_dmg_factor > 0 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_sam_fire_control } } }
					add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_sam_fire_control }
				}
			}
			else = {
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_sam_fire_control }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			# Battery lost or destroyed.
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_sam_fire_control } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_sam_fire_control }
			set_variable = { wif_sam_hit_factor = 0 }
			set_variable = { wif_sam_dmg_factor = 0 }
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { wif_sam_fired_total = wif_t_fired }
}

# Called by every nuclear MISSILE raid (common/raids/nuclear_raids.txt) in the target state's
# scope before the warhead lands. Sets temp wif_t_intercepted = 1 if a SAM hits.
# Fixed chances per SAM (17 % radar-guided, 10 % heat-seeking): no tech changes them.
wif_sam_intercept_nuke = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_t_intercepted = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			wif_sam_battery > 0
			controller = { has_tech = wif_sam_battery_tech }
		}
		save_global_event_target_as = wif_sam_nuke_state
		set_temp_variable = { wif_t_shots = building_level@wif_sam_battery }
		controller = {
			for_loop_effect = {
				end = wif_t_shots
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_intercepted = 0 } }
					wif_sam_nuke_shot = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# One SAM at an incoming nuclear missile (country scope: the defender).
wif_sam_nuke_shot = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_equipment = { wif_rd_sam_equipment > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = wif_rd_sam_equipment_1 amount = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sam_fired_total = 1 }
		random = {
			chance = 17
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_intercepted = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_equipment = { wif_hs_sam_equipment > 0 } }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = wif_hs_sam_equipment_1 amount = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sam_fired_total = 1 }
		random = {
			chance = 10
			set_temp_variable = { wif_t_intercepted = 1 }
		}
	}
}
